description: This PHP file contains common utility functions used across the system module of the phpSysInfo project. It includes functions for generating HTML components such as bar graphs, executing system commands, reading files, handling directories, and various system-related utilities.

methods.name: created_by
methods.description: Generates an HTML comment indicating the creation details of the script, including version information.

methods.name: create_bargraph
methods.description: Creates an HTML image-based bar graph representing a percentage value with color coding based on thresholds.

methods.name: create_bargraph_grad
methods.description: Creates an animated gradient bar graph illustrating a percentage value.

methods.name: direction
methods.description: Determines text directionality (LTR or RTL) based on global setting.

methods.name: find_program
methods.description: Attempts to locate a system program in common executable paths, returning the full path if found.

methods.name: execute_program
methods.description: Executes a system program with optional arguments, capturing and returning its output.

methods.name: format_bytesize
methods.description: Formats a byte size into a human-readable string with appropriate units.

methods.name: get_gif_image_height
methods.description: Reads a GIF image to determine its height by parsing the file header.

methods.name: hide_mount
methods.description: Checks if a given mount point should be hidden based on a global list.

methods.name: uptime
methods.description: Converts a timestamp into a human-readable uptime string in days, hours, and minutes.

methods.name: replace_specialchars
methods.description: Replaces special characters in an XML string with safe representations.

methods.name: finddups
methods.description: Identifies duplicate entries in an array and annotates their count.

methods.name: rfts
methods.description: Reads a specified number of lines from a file, useful for tail-like operations.

methods.name: gdc
methods.description: Lists the contents of a directory, excluding certain system entries.
